section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 2001
title: During the year 2001, out of 2,71,019 accidental deaths, 2,34,368 (86.5%) deaths were caused by un-natural causes and the rest 13.5% deaths (36,651) were caused by natural causes. As compared to 2000, there was significant increase (111.1%) in deaths due to natural causes and a marginal decline of 1.7 per cent in these deaths due to un-natural causes resulting in an overall increase of 5.9 per cent.
